name: Precise Rays
body:
You are particularly adept at aiming your ray spells.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (ray), sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When making an attack roll with a ray you ignore any penalties on the roll for your target being in melee. In addition, when making a sneak attack, or other precision based attack which adds damage dice, with a ray you may reroll your precision damage once per round, this requires no action.
